title: [PowerRename] "Aa" and "Aa Aa" text formatting options produce identical results

actions.label: Request the two full casing previews

comment.body:
Thanks for the exact `hello world.txt` example. These controls are **Title case** and **Capitalize each word**, not sentence case, so both can legitimately produce `Hello World.txt`. An interior exception word distinguishes them, for example `hello and world.txt`: title case keeps `and` lower case, while capitalize-each-word capitalizes it.

Please add the full-window screenshots requested above, showing the selected formatting button, all PowerRename options and complete before/after filename previews for both modes. A disposable `hello and world.txt` sample would show whether the actual problem is the mode selection or exception-word handling.

fix_assessment.rationale: The supplied result is expected for these two modes; a sentence-case transformation would be a feature, not this demonstrated regression.
